experts.description_zh: 把需求变成可直接部署的静态站点：页面结构、Tailwind 样式、响应式断点与可访问性，交付完整源码并在本地跑通验证。
experts.description_en: Turn a brief into a deployable static site: page structure, Tailwind styling, responsive breakpoints and accessibility, delivered as complete source that was actually run and checked.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
我想做一个网站，请先把需求拆成页面清单、导航结构和每页要解决的问题。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
I want to build a website. Start by turning the brief into a page list, a navigation structure and the problem each page solves.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请按这份页面清单生成完整的 HTML + Tailwind 站点源码，包含响应式断点和可访问性处理。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Generate the complete HTML + Tailwind source for this page list, including responsive breakpoints and accessibility.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请给出这个站点上线前的检查清单：页面可达、对比度、死链、图片体积和移动端表现。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Give me a pre-launch checklist for this site: reachable pages, contrast, dead links, image weight and mobile rendering.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 规划 AI 换脸与人物替换：核对素材与授权，判断当前环境是否有可用的换脸模型，没有时给出可执行的替代方案，而不是编造成品视频。
experts.description_en: Plan AI face swap and character replacement: check materials and consent, decide whether a usable face-swap model exists in this environment, and when it does not, deliver an executable alternative instead of a fabricated video.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
我有一段人物视频和一张目标人脸照片，请先评估能否换脸，列出需要的素材、授权和当前环境的限制。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
I have a video of a person and a photo of the target face. Assess whether a face swap is feasible and list the materials, the consent it needs and the limits of this environment.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请为我的素材写出一份可执行的换脸步骤与提示词，并说明每一步需要什么工具、产物怎么检查。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Write an executable face-swap procedure and prompts for my materials, naming the tool each step needs and how to check its output.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.label_zh: 没有模型时的替代方案
quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
如果当前环境没有可用的换脸模型，请给出可执行的替代方案，包括开源工具、安装命令和成品检查清单。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
If this environment has no usable face-swap model, give me an executable alternative: open-source tooling, install commands and a checklist for the result.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 用 Seedream 精修已有图片：写清改什么与保留什么，真的调用模型产出成片，模型不可用时给出可运行的本地替代脚本。
experts.description_en: Retouch an existing image with Seedream: state what changes and what must be preserved, actually call the model, and fall back to a runnable local script when no model is available.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
我要修这张图，请先把修改要求写成模型能直接读懂的编辑指令，标明必须保留的部分。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
I need to retouch this image. Turn my request into an instruction a model can execute, naming what must be preserved.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请按这份指令真的调模型完成精修，并核实产物尺寸、可解码性和保留项是否达标。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Actually run the retouch against the model and verify the output's dimensions, decodability and preserved elements.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.label_zh: 模型不可用时的本地方案
quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
如果当前环境调不到图片编辑模型，请给出可运行的 ImageMagick 或 Pillow 脚本完成能本地做的部分。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
If no image-editing model is reachable, give me runnable ImageMagick or Pillow scripts for the parts local tooling can do.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 用 Seedream 生成可控人像写真：人物设定、光线、镜头与负面约束，先出样片核对再出整组，模型不可用时交付可直接跑的提示词包。
experts.description_en: Generate controlled portraits with Seedream: subject, lighting, lens and negative constraints, a sample image checked before the set, and an executable prompt pack when no model is available.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
我要一组有特定感觉的人像，请写出人物设定、光线、镜头、背景和负面约束的完整提示词。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
I want a portrait set with a specific feel. Write the full prompts: subject, lighting, lens, background and negative constraints.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请先生成一张样片，核对人物一致性、手部和画幅，再出整组并记录每张的参数。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Generate one sample first, verify character consistency, hands and aspect ratio, then produce the set and record each image's parameters.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
如果当前环境没有可用的图片生成模型，请交付完整提示词包、参数表和成品检查清单。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
If no image-generation model is available, deliver the complete prompt pack, parameter table and a checklist for the result.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 视频翻译全流程：本地 ASR 转写带时间戳、逐段翻译与校对、生成 SRT 并可烧录进画面；配音需要 TTS，没有可用 provider 时不伪造音轨。
experts.description_en: End-to-end video translation: local ASR with timestamps, segment-level translation and review, SRT output and optional burn-in; dubbing needs TTS and is never faked when no provider is available.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请把这个视频转写成带时间戳的文稿并翻译成目标语言，先给我字幕文件。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Transcribe this video with timestamps and translate it into the target language. Start with the subtitle file.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请把这份字幕烧录进视频，核对时长和音轨没有被改动。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Burn these subtitles into the video and verify the duration and audio track are unchanged.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请确认当前环境能不能生成译制配音；不能的话说明原因，并给出可执行的替代路径。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Check whether this environment can produce dubbed audio; if not, say why and give an executable alternative.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 撰写可直接录制或合成的口播稿：断句、重音、气口与时长，并逐步核实本机真实可用的 TTS 路径，没有验证通过就如实说明。
experts.description_en: Write a voiceover script ready to record or synthesize: phrasing, stress, breath and duration, and verify the TTS path this machine really has instead of assuming one.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请把这段文案改成口播稿，标出断句、重音和气口，并估算时长。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Turn this copy into a voiceover script with phrasing, stress and breath marks, and estimate its duration.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请逐步核实本机有哪些可用的 TTS 路径，并用一句话真实合成一次来确认。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Check step by step which TTS paths this machine really has and confirm one by actually synthesizing a sentence.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.label_zh: 没有 TTS 时怎么做
quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
如果核实不到可用的 TTS，请交付完整口播稿和可直接执行的本地合成命令。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
If no usable TTS verifies, deliver the finished script plus local synthesis commands I can run myself.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 读长文档并带页码引用回答：抽取文本、保留位置锚点、逐条核对出处，读不出来的部分如实说明。
experts.description_en: Read long documents and answer with page citations: extract text, keep location anchors, verify every quote, and say plainly what could not be read.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请读完这份文档并回答我的问题，每条结论都标注页码或条款号。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Read this document and answer my questions, citing the page or clause for every conclusion.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请把这份文档里的关键条款、义务和风险整理成清单，并给出对应页码。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Turn the key clauses, obligations and risks in this document into a list with the matching page numbers.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.label_en: When the text will not extract
quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
如果这份文档抽取不出文本，请说明原因并给出可执行的 OCR 或转换步骤。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
If this document yields no text, explain why and give me the OCR or conversion steps to run.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 按目标岗位改写简历并渲染 PDF：JD 逐条映射、只使用真实经历与数字、渲染后核对页数与文字，缺口如实标出。
experts.description_en: Rewrite a resume for a target role and render it to PDF: map the JD line by line, use only real experience and numbers, verify the rendered file, and name the gaps.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请按目标岗位把这份简历逐条改写，并列出 JD 要求与经历的映射表。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Rewrite this resume against the target role and give me a mapping table from each JD requirement to my experience.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请把改好的简历渲染成 PDF，核对页数、排版和文字有没有乱码。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Render the revised resume to PDF and verify the page count, layout and text extraction.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请列出这份简历相对目标岗位的缺口，以及需要我补充的真实数字。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
List what this resume is missing relative to the target role, and which real numbers I need to supply.
My context, goals, or materials are:

experts.description_zh: 用 Python 本地读表并回答问题：先探查结构再清洗计算，结论带口径与可复现代码，对不上的数字如实说明。
experts.description_en: Read a spreadsheet locally with Python and answer the question: explore the structure before cleaning and computing, and ship conclusions with their definitions and reproducible code.

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请先探查这张表的结构：工作表、列类型、行数、缺失和合计行，再告诉我能回答哪些问题。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Explore this workbook first: sheets, column types, row counts, missing values and total rows, then tell me what questions it can answer.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请按我的问题完成计算，给出结论、口径和可以直接运行的代码。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Answer my question with a computation, and give me the conclusion, its definitions and the code that reproduces it.
My context, goals, or materials are:

quick_prompts.prompt_zh:
请交叉核对这张表的总计、占比和抽样行，指出对不上的地方。
我的情况/目标/材料是：
quick_prompts.prompt_en:
Cross-check the totals, shares and sampled rows in this sheet and point out what does not reconcile.
My context, goals, or materials are:
